topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: The rain's been coming down hard, streets glistening like they're walking on thin ice. Got a call from this guy, says his life's work, this invention he's poured his last dime into, is already patented. Someone beat him to it, and now he's staring at the abyss. I've seen this before, when dreams shatter on the pavement. You can almost hear the sound. He swears he's clean, says it's a mix-up, a theft of ideas. But I've heard plenty of stories, and not all of them end well. You learn to watch your step in this town, especially when someone's got everything to lose. I'm taking the case, but I'm keeping my eyes open, looking for exits.
